rule: Brief v4 (9 October 2026): page-level drafting after a source search for free full texts; the model verifies every factual claim against the papers and records verdicts with verbatim quotes; no checking tasks are left to contributors. Earlier drafts are kept for comparison. Brief v4.1 (10 October 2026): a clear abstract is sufficient for what it plainly states; 28 pages with abstract-only sources were re-drafted after more abstracts and article-cited papers were looked up. Four re-drafts whose action changed without any new evidence (Positive illusions x2, Naive cynicism, Jan Eeckhout) were not adopted.
